prakriya rakh_tak_mala(s, cap, out) {
    vitti tmp = nirmmita(s[0] * 33 + 1)
    vitti scratch = nirmmita(s[0] * 32 + 1)
    vitti ptrs = nirmmita(s[0] * 8)
    vitti lens = nirmmita(s[0] * 8)
    yadi (tmp == 0 || scratch == 0) { nivartanam 0 - 1 }
    yadi (ptrs == 0 || lens == 0) { nivartanam 0 - 1 }
    vitti nk = nighantu_kunjika_ashtak(s, tmp)
    vitti pos = 0
    vitti i = 0
    vitti j = 0
    vitti seglen = 0
    vitti wpos = 0
    vitti woff = 0
    vitti tp = 0
    vitti tl = 0
    vitti k = 0
    # copy every byte segment into one scratch byte area, recording
    # (byte-offset, len) pairs; khand_tul needs packed bytes.
    # R17: segments are already bytes, so this is a plain byte copy.
    yavat (i < nk) {
        seglen = akshar(tmp, pos)
        ptrs[i] = woff
        lens[i] = seglen
        k = 0
        yavat (k < seglen) {
            akshar_rakh(scratch, woff + k, akshar(tmp, pos + 1 + k))
            k = k + 1
        }
        woff = woff + seglen
        pos = pos + 1 + seglen
        i = i + 1
    }
    # bubble-sort the pairs by element bytes
    i = 0
    yavat (i < nk - 1) {
        j = 0
        yavat (j < nk - 1 - i) {
            yadi (khand_tul(scratch + ptrs[j], lens[j], scratch + ptrs[j + 1], lens[j + 1]) > 0) {
                tp = ptrs[j]
                ptrs[j] = ptrs[j + 1]
                ptrs[j + 1] = tp
                tl = lens[j]
                lens[j] = lens[j + 1]
                lens[j + 1] = tl
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    # emit in sorted order; unpack writes a 0 cell at the next length
    # slot, which the next segment's length overwrites (or trails).
    wpos = 0
    i = 0
    yavat (i < nk) {
        out[wpos] = lens[i]
        khand_mukt(scratch + ptrs[i], lens[i], out + (wpos + 1) * 8)
        wpos = wpos + 1 + lens[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    nivartanam nk
}

# A queue is a RING BUFFER over the same kind of cell array: elements

prakriya varna_viparyay(src, sn, out) {
    vitti s = src
    vitti n = sn
    vitti dst = out
    vitti i = 0
    vitti j = 0
    vitti t = 0
    yadi (n <= 0) {
        dst[0] = 0
        nivartanam 0
    }
    i = 0
    j = n - 1
    yavat (i < j) {
        t = s[i]
        dst[i] = s[j]
        dst[j] = t
        i = i + 1
        j = j - 1
    }
    yadi (n % 2 == 1) {
        dst[n / 2] = s[n / 2]
    }
    dst[n] = 0
    nivartanam n
}
